links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified OTA/AO patient education articles
links.outcome: Readability (FKGL and FRE) of patient education articles
links.effect: FKGL reduced from 8.2 ± 1.1 to 5.7 ± 0.5 (P < 0.001); FRE increased from 65.5 ± 6.6 to 76.4 ± 5.7 (P < 0.001); 29 (70.7%) revised articles accurate without modification
links.tradeoff: Content omissions: 3 (7.3%) articles needed minor modifications and 9 (22%) needed substantial edits, so nearly a third required revision.
links.quote: ChatGPT significantly reduced the FKGL (8.2 ± 1.1‒5.7 ± 0.5, P < 0.001) and increased the FRE (65.5 ± 6.6‒76.4 ± 5.7, P < 0.001) of the OTA/AO patient education articles.

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt with expert clinician review of outputs
